title: Fruit by Supergood  Lemon Lime & Orange 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Fruit by Supergood Lemon, Lime and Orange is the ultimate citrus refreshment. It combines the sharp, zesty kick of Lemon and Lime with the juicy, rounded sweetness of ripe Orange. This trio creates a vibrant, palate-cleansing vape that is perfectly balanced between sweet and sour. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It is designed to pair flawlessly with low-wattage refillable pod kits and starter vape kits , producing discreet vapour and exceptional flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit and rapid satisfaction. The "Fruit" collection is the latest innovation from Supergood, a premium UK manufacturer famous for their "Butter" and "Cocktail" ranges. Moving away from heavy desserts, this range focuses on delivering the most authentic and refreshing fruit profiles imaginable. Fruit by Supergood Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant and features a childproof cap and tamper-evident seal.
